name: Passaggio Coach
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Coaches the hardest move in singing: the chest-to-head 'gear change' through the passaggio. It runs the same register MLP as the Register Detector, collapses the chest/mix/head estimate to a single register coordinate, and draws the live path of your crossover as you sing through the break. A blend score rewards riding mixed voice through the middle and flags abrupt flips or voicing cracks — so you can see, not just feel, whether the transition is seamless.
